items.source: The default implementation returns the given bean as-is.
items.translation: 默认实现原样返回给定的bean。

items.source:
Web application contexts will automatically register this with their
underlying bean factory. Applications do not use this directly.
items.translation: Web 应用程序上下文会自动将其注册到其底层的 BeanFactory 中。应用程序不会直接使用此功能。

items.source: Create a new ServletContextAwareProcessor without an initial context or config. When this constructor is used the getServletContext() and/or getServletConfig() methods should be overridden.
items.translation: 创建一个不带初始上下文或配置的新的 ServletContextAwareProcessor。当使用此构造函数时，应重写 getServletContext() 和/或 getServletConfig() 方法。

items.source: Returns the ServletContext to be injected or null. This method can be overridden by subclasses when a context is obtained after the post-processor has been registered.
items.translation: 返回要注入的`ServletContext`或`null`。当在注册后处理器之后获取上下文时，子类可以重写此方法。

items.source: Returns the ServletConfig to be injected or null. This method can be overridden by subclasses when a context is obtained after the post-processor has been registered.
items.translation: 返回要注入的 `ServletConfig` 或 `null`。当在注册后处理器之后获取上下文时，子类可以重写此方法。

items.source: bean - the new bean instance
items.translation: bean - 新的 bean 实例

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称

items.source: the bean instance to use, either the original or a wrapped one; if null, no subsequent BeanPostProcessors will be invoked
items.translation: 要使用的 Bean 实例，即原始实例或包装后的实例；如果为null，则不会调用后续的 BeanPostProcessor。

items.source: This callback will also be invoked after a short-circuiting triggered by a InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String) method, in contrast to all other BeanPostProcessor callbacks.
items.translation: 此回调也会在由`InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.postProcessBeforeInstantiation(Class, String)`方法触发的短路之后被调用，这与所有其他`BeanPostProcessor`回调不同。

items.source: In case of a FactoryBean, this callback will be invoked for both the FactoryBean instance and the objects created by the FactoryBean. The post-processor can decide whether to apply to either the FactoryBean or created objects or both through corresponding bean instanceof FactoryBean checks.
items.translation: 对于 FactoryBean，此回调将针对 FactoryBean 实例以及由 FactoryBean 创建的对象均被调用。后处理器可以通过相应的 `bean instanceof FactoryBean` 检查来决定是应用于 FactoryBean、创建的对象还是两者。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance after any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).
items.translation: 将此 `BeanPostProcessor` 应用于给定的新 Bean 实例，且是在任何 Bean 初始化回调（例如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之后。

items.source: Apply this BeanPostProcessor to the given new bean instance before any bean initialization callbacks (like InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet or a custom init-method).
items.translation: 将此 `BeanPostProcessor` 应用于给定的新 Bean 实例，在任意 Bean 初始化回调（例如 `InitializingBean` 的 `afterPropertiesSet` 或自定义的 init-method）之前。
